args.summary:
Modeled a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete continuous box girder bridge (30+40+30 m bearing centre-lines, deck 12.5 m wide) as a 2D spine-beam OpenSeesPy model with pier columns.

Key modeling decisions:
- structure.idealization = spine_beam_2d (MR-01); structure.system = continuous_on_piers (MR-05), since pier column geometry is given.
- Single-cell cast box girder section integrated: A = 6.532 m², I = 3.564 m⁴ (MR-02). Ec = 34500 MPa (C50, JTG3362-3.1.5), γ = 26.0 kN/m³ (JTGD60-4.2.1), w = 169.83 kN/m, m = 17.31 t/m (MR-07).
- Piers as combined single columns: A = 4.021 m², I = 0.6434 m⁴ (twin Ø1.6 m), Ec = 32500 MPa (C40); Pier 1 H=14 m, Pier 2 H=8 m (MR-06).
- Bearings (laminated elastomeric, Ge=1.2 MPa manufacturer value): Abutments 0/3 and Pier 1 PTFE sliding (2 per line, S=10.10/13.54, Kv=3.61e6/8.08e6 kN/m, Kh=0); Pier 2 plain fixed (2 per line, S=14.69, Kv=8.97e6 kN/m, Kh=13091 kN/m) (MR-03/MR-04, JTG3362-8.7).
- Live load Highway Class I: 3 lanes, ξ=0.78, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk=320/340/320 kN, impact μ=0.2023 from f1 (JTGD60-4.3).

Results: first vertical frequency f1 = 3.434 Hz. Self-weight support reactions ≈ [1840, 6646, 6666, 1832] kN; mid-span moments ≈ [8490, 12616, 8372] kN·m; support moments ≈ [-21233, -21469] kN·m. Lane-load extreme moments: max positive 9701 kN·m (mid-span 2), max negative -7558 kN·m. Model passed all L1/L2/L3 checks.
